status: frozen-draft (development canaries only; production requires the go/no-go of docs/GO_NO_GO_100K.md)

source_rule.count: 1..4, chosen by the controller before sources are drawn
source_rule.prior: uniform on D(G) = FREE with certified clearance > 2^-26

exclusion: every source outside every accepted closed window box [o/N, (o+L)/N]^3
informative: channel j of window W is informative iff W has a lit FREE and a dark FREE receiver for source j; m(W) = number of informative channels; every accepted window has m >= 1

controller.prior: natural m statistics of the independent release_1k_v1 rate streams (seed 20261120)

splits: sha256(scene_id) mod 100: < 80 train, < 90 val, else test

labels.target: Uniform(F_W^j) over D(G) minus the closed window box, cell masses on the 128^3 grid

storage.responses: per (window, source) packed bits (Z,Y,X), zstd; SOLID once per window
